title: AI is awful at making video games
author: fisj

comments.author: _stevencasteel_
comments.body:
Not gonna bother watching this clickbait. He didn't even label 01 as preview which is half as good as the full version coming out next month.

Nobody ever said it could make Sonic and Mario for you easily.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet built my entire personal website from scratch, and it ranks behind 01 preview.

I'm very impressed and looking forward to two more papers down the line.

comments.author: fisj
comments.body:
I'd like to think I avoid most clickbait. The main reason for me posting this is a dose of sanity amongst the hype. I use generative models every day, and a lot of my challenges revolve around educating others on genAI models not being a silver bullet but another tool in the toolbag.

He brings up some good points, I think primarily that if you have no language or experience to prompt correctly, then its garbage in garbage out. The other point being that regenerating the code also introduces new possibilities for bugs. Obviously, an experienced developer can do this piecemeal, but the context here is a nocode developer, so I think it stands.

comments.author: GKP_light
comments.body: It is obvious that if you want the IA to be able to do a game alone and from nothing, you have to wait at least 25 year, and this would be very very optimistic about the AI progress.

replies.author: odragora
replies.body: It will be possible within next 5 years, and this would be very conservative about the AI progress and integration of AI into the tools and toolchains everywhere.

comments.author: mikebrave
comments.body: If the AI could do the whole thing by itself nobody would want it. It's like how cake mixes make you add eggs, they didn't used to and don't need to, it's so you feel like you contributed to baking it. AI is for collaborating with, not for hand waving delegation like "make me a whole game from scratch, no further instructions".
